title: Describing Visual Art and Composition
grammar: Adverbial participles (-va/-ve) for simultaneous manner and posture
goal: I can form adverbial participles with -va/-ve across regular and irregular verb stems (állva, mosolyogva, elragadtatva)
I can compress two simultaneous actions by the same subject into an adverbial participial phrase
I can describe visual composition, light, and emotional response to art

sections.title: Unit 6: Aesthetics, Vision & Creative Obsession
body: Fin-de-siècle Hungarian art and literature—from the visionary paintings of Tivadar Csontváry Kosztka and Lajos Gulácsy to the symbolist tales of Géza Csáth—explored the boundary between waking reality and dreamlike obsession. Describing visual composition, brushwork, and psychological states at B2 demands complete command of Hungarian's adverbial participles (határozói igenevek).

In this unit, you will master simultaneous manner participles in -va/-ve (elragadtatva nézte), the crucial distinction between the stative resultative construction (be van aranyozva) and dynamic mediopassive verbs (aranyozódik), and the elevated causal-anterior participle in -ván/-vén (látván a mesterművet).
